notify.blind_alert: The indoor temperature sensor stopped reporting while a ventilation fan is running, so Climate Advisor can't tell whether the house is getting too cold. {outcome, select, will_stop {Climate Advisor will turn the fan off at {time} if it doesn't come back.} override {The fan was turned on manually (or by its remote), so Climate Advisor will NOT turn it off — you may want to.} other {Climate Advisor will not turn this fan off automatically — you may want to.}}
notify.blind_recovered: The indoor temperature sensor is reporting again {when, select, short {after a short outage} at_least {after at least {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}} other {after about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}. {tail, select, stopped {The fan stays off; ventilation may resume if conditions allow.} running {Climate Advisor is monitoring the fan normally again.} other {The fan is no longer running.}}
notify.blind_stopped: The indoor temperature sensor has been unavailable for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, so Climate Advisor turned the ventilation fan off to avoid overcooling the house. Please check the sensor.
notify.close_windows: It's {indoor} inside, above your {limit} comfort limit, and the windows are open. Climate Advisor won't run the air conditioning with the windows open. Close the windows and it will cool the house.
notify.control_command_failing: Thermostat commands are failing (last attempted mode: {mode}) for {minutes} min
notify.control_mode_not_obeyed: Thermostat is not following the requested mode: requested {requested}, reports {live}
notify.control_mode_not_obeyed_for: Thermostat is not following the requested mode: requested {requested}, reports {live} for {minutes} min
notify.control_output_stall: House has been {gap} {direction, select, heat {below} other {above}} the comfort band for {hours, plural, one {# h} other {# h}} with no {direction, select, heat {heating} other {cooling}} running ({diag})
notify.door_window_paused: 🚪 HVAC paused — a monitored door/window is open. Heating/cooling will resume when it's closed.
notify.door_window_paused_named: 🚪 HVAC paused — {name} has been open for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Heating/cooling will resume when it's closed.
notify.entity_consequence_door_closed: It last read closed, so Climate Advisor treats it as closed. If that door or window is actually open, heating or cooling may run.
notify.entity_consequence_door_open: It last read open, so heating and cooling stay paused until it reports again or you change the thermostat.
notify.entity_consequence_door_unknown: It hasn't reported since Climate Advisor started, so Climate Advisor treats it as closed. If that door or window is actually open, heating or cooling may run.
notify.entity_consequence_thermostat_whf: The whole-house fan is running, and Climate Advisor can't check that the fan and heating/cooling are never on together until the thermostat responds. Turn the heating or cooling off yourself if it is on.
notify.entity_generic_consequence_multi: Climate Advisor may not be able to control your HVAC correctly until they're fixed.
notify.entity_generic_consequence_single: Climate Advisor may not be able to control your HVAC correctly until it's fixed.
notify.entity_health_multi: {count, plural, one {# entity isn't responding} other {# entities aren't responding}}: {names}. {details} Check Settings > Devices & Services.
notify.entity_health_single: {name} (''{entity_id}'') isn't responding. {consequence} Check Settings > Devices & Services.
notify.grace_expired_automation: Automation grace period expired ({minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}). HVAC will now respond normally to door/window sensor changes.
notify.grace_expired_manual: Your manual thermostat override has expired. Climate Advisor has resumed automated control.
notify.grace_repause: Grace period expired but a door/window is still open. HVAC has been paused again.
notify.invariant_ac_whf_mutex: AC is actively {hvac_action} while the whole-house fan is physically running — these must never run at the same time.
notify.invariant_violated: {detail} Climate Advisor's whole-house-fan safety check is acting on this where it can, but it is flagged because it should never happen.
notify.override_self_resolved: Brief thermostat adjustment detected — treated as transient (reverted within confirmation window). Climate Advisor continues normal operation.
notify.promise_p10_settles: Climate Advisor switched the thermostat between heat and cool {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in the past {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
notify.promise_p1_cool: Your AC started {since, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} after the heat ran, while the house was {near, select, at {right at} other {only {dip} over}} your comfort maximum. It should have waited.
notify.promise_p1_heat: Your heat started {since, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} after the AC cooled the house, while the house was {near, select, at {right at} other {only {dip} under}} your comfort minimum. It should have waited.
notify.promise_p3_silence: Climate Advisor sent a command to your thermostat or fan while automation was switched off.
notify.promise_p4_changed: Climate Advisor changed your {target, select, thermostat {thermostat} other {fan}} setting {when, select, in_force {while your manual change was still in force} other {{minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} before your manual change was due to end}}.
notify.promise_p4_early_end: Climate Advisor ended your manual {target, select, thermostat {thermostat} other {fan}} change {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} early, so nothing protects it any more.
notify.promise_p5_blind_start: The fan was started while the indoor temperature could not be read.
notify.promise_p5b_blind_continue: The fan ran {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} while the indoor temperature could not be read.
notify.promise_p6_flip_rate: The thermostat flipped between heat and cool {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in the past hour.
notify.promise_p7_comfort_kept: The house stayed {worst} outside your comfort range for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} while Climate Advisor was in control.
notify.promise_p9_whf_sealed: The whole-house fan ran {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} with every door and window closed.
notify.stall_message: The house is {gap} {direction, select, heat {below} other {above}} your comfort band ({edge}) and the {direction, select, heat {heating} other {cooling}} hasn't run for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} ({diag}).
notify.title.blind_alert: Climate Advisor: fan running without a temperature reading
notify.title.blind_recovered: Climate Advisor: indoor temperature is back
notify.title.blind_stopped: Climate Advisor: ventilation fan turned off
notify.title.entities_mixed: Climate Advisor — entities unavailable or not found
notify.title.whf_observe_rule2: Climate Advisor — whole-house fan and heating/cooling both on
notify.title.whf_observe_sealed: Climate Advisor — whole-house fan on with the house closed up
notify.title.whf_oscillation: Climate Advisor — whole-house fan keeps being turned on
notify.title.whf_sealed_promise: Climate Advisor — whole-house fan ran on a sealed house
notify.title.whf_stop_failed: Climate Advisor — whole-house fan could not be stopped
notify.welcome_home_hold: 🏠 Welcome home! Comfort temperature will resume once {hold, select, manual_override {your manual thermostat change} override_confirm_pending {your pending thermostat change} paused_by_door {the open door/window} open_sensor {the open door/window} other {the hold}} clears.
notify.welcome_home_restoring: 🏠 Welcome home! Restoring comfort temperature. Should feel normal in about 20–30 minutes.
notify.welcome_home_ventilation: 🏠 Welcome home! Comfort temperature will resume once ventilation ends.
notify.whf_hvac_off: Climate Advisor turned off the heating/cooling because the whole-house fan was running beside it. The fan and the heating/cooling are never run together, and the most recent change wins.
notify.whf_observe_rule2: The whole-house fan and the heating/cooling are running at the same time, and automation is switched off, so Climate Advisor will not turn either off. Turn one of them off.
notify.whf_observe_sealed: The whole-house fan is running while every door and window is closed, and automation is switched off, so Climate Advisor will not turn it off. Turn the fan off, or open a window.
notify.whf_oscillation: The whole-house fan was turned on {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in 10 minutes and Climate Advisor stopped it each time. Check what keeps switching it on (a remote, a HomeKit automation, a schedule).
notify.whf_reason_backstop_confirming: rule-2 state backstop: fan and heating/cooling both on — confirming before acting
notify.whf_reason_backstop_stop_fan: rule-2 state backstop: thermostat switched to {mode} after the fan came on and is {action} beside it ({seconds}s) — stopping the fan (newest action wins)
notify.whf_reason_backstop_suppress_hvac: rule-2 state backstop: thermostat {action} ({mode}) beside the running fan ({seconds}s) — suppressing heating/cooling (the fan is the newer action)
notify.whf_reason_occupant_fan_after_hva: occupant turned the fan on after HVAC ({mode}) — newest action wins
notify.whf_reason_occupant_hvac_after_fa: occupant turned HVAC on ({mode}) after the fan — newest action wins
notify.whf_reason_sealed_settling: sealed house — settling before stopping the fan
notify.whf_reason_sealed_stop: whole-house fan running with every door/window closed
notify.whf_reason_stop_in_flight: stop in flight ({elapsed}s of {window}s): awaiting the physical reading
notify.whf_sealed_promise: {detail} The safety check should have stopped it within 30 seconds; please report this.
notify.whf_stale_sensors: {names} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} been unavailable for over a minute. Climate Advisor counts {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} as closed when deciding whether the whole-house fan may run.
notify.whf_stop_failed: The whole-house fan is running with every door and window closed and Climate Advisor could not stop it: {detail}. Turn it off at the remote or the wall switch, or open a window.
notify.whf_stop_failed_detail_attempts: the fan was still running after {attempts, plural, one {# off command} other {# off commands}}
notify.whf_stop_failed_detail_control_of: control entity already reads off (firmware may not reflect remote power state)
notify.whf_stopped_rule2: Climate Advisor turned off the whole-house fan because the heating/cooling was turned on after it. The fan and the heating/cooling are never run together, and the most recent change wins.
notify.whf_stopped_sealed: Climate Advisor turned off the whole-house fan because every monitored door and window is closed. It will not restart the fan until a window opens.
